title: Duniyar aiki
description: Ten short stories about the world of work: a porter at the Dawanau grain market in Kano, a lame builder and his careless apprentice in Zaria, a textile factory in Kaduna taken to court over its chemicals, a woman's phone repair shop in Katsina, a food seller near a Gombe motor park, a hired herder and his son near Sokoto, a young policeman's first night patrol in Maiduguri, a lawyer at a sharia court in Kano, a news agency reporter during a war abroad, and an old wedding entertainer and poet in Katsina.

lessons.title: Sabitu ɗan dako
lessons.summary: In Kano, the young porter Sabitu unloads thirty tons of grain at the Dawanau grain market, learns from an old porter to bend his knees instead of his back, scoops up spilled grain with a bucket, and is paid in the evening.
lessons.text:
Sabitu saurayi ne ɗan shekara ashirin da ɗaya. Ya zo Kano daga wani ƙauye a jihar Jigawa domin ya nemi aiki. Bai yi karatun boko mai yawa ba, saboda haka ya fara aikin dako a kasuwar hatsi ta Dawanau. Aikin dako yana da wuya, amma yana ba shi abin da zai ci, har ma yakan aika wa iyayensa kuɗi a ƙauye.

Kowace safiya Sabitu yakan zo kasuwa da wuri tare da sauran 'yan dako. Suna zaune a ƙarƙashin wata babbar bishiya suna jiran manyan motocin da suke kawo hatsi daga ƙauyuka. Idan mota ta iso, sai su tashi da sauri, domin kowa yana son ya samu aiki.

Wata rana wata babbar mota ta iso ɗauke da tan 30 na hatsi: masara, gero da shinkafa. Mai hatsin, Alhaji Ɗanhausa, ya kira Sabitu da wasu 'yan dako uku. Ya ce musu, "Ina so ku sauke wannan hatsi duka kafin maraice. Zan biya ku naira 100 a kan kowane buhu." Sabitu ya yi lissafi a ransa. Tan 30 na hatsi, buhu 600 ke nan.

Suka fara aiki. Sabitu yakan lanƙwasa bayansa, abokinsa ya ɗora masa buhu a kai, sannan ya kai shi cikin ɗakin ajiyar Alhaji. Buhun yana da nauyi sosai. Wani tsoho ɗan dako ya ce masa, "Kada ka lanƙwasa baya kawai. Ka lanƙwasa gwiwoyinka. In ba haka ba, bayanka zai yi maka ciwo." Sabitu ya bi shawararsa.

Gab da azahar, wani buhu ya fashe, sai hatsi ya zube a ƙasa. Alhaji Ɗanhausa ya ce, "Kada ku bar hatsina a ƙasa. Ku ɗebe shi duka." Sabitu ya ɗauko wani bokiti, ya ɗebe hatsin da hannunsa ya zuba a cikin bokitin. Ya ɗebe har sai da babu ko ɗaya a ƙasa. Bokitin ya cika sau biyu.

Suka ci gaba da aiki har rana ta fara faɗuwa. Gab da maraice, buhu na ƙarshe ya shiga ɗakin ajiya. Jikin Sabitu duka yana ciwo, amma yana farin ciki. Da maraice ya yi, Alhaji Ɗanhausa ya kira su domin ya biya su. Ya ce, "Jimillar buhunan 600 ne, kuma kowannenku ya ɗauki buhu 150. Ga jimillar kuɗinku." Ya ba kowannensu naira 15,000. Sabitu ya ce, "Na gode, Alhaji. Allah ya ƙara arziki."

Washegari da safe Sabitu ya tashi, bayansa yana ɗan ciwo. Duk da haka ya koma kasuwa. Washegarin ma wata mota ta iso. A wannan karon, Sabitu ya lanƙwasa gwiwoyinsa kamar yadda tsohon ya koya masa, kuma bayansa bai yi masa ciwo sosai ba. Da maraice ya aika wa mahaifiyarsa wani ɓangare na kuɗinsa.

Tambayoyi:
Wane aiki Sabitu yake yi?
Yana aikin dako a kasuwar hatsi ta Dawanau a Kano.
Tan nawa na hatsi motar ta kawo?
Motar ta kawo tan 30 na hatsi.
Me Sabitu ya yi da hatsin da ya zube?
Ya ɗebe hatsin da hannunsa ya zuba a cikin bokiti.
Me tsohon ya ce masa game da lanƙwasa baya?
Ya ce kada ya lanƙwasa baya kawai, ya lanƙwasa gwiwoyinsa.
Nawa ne jimillar kuɗin da kowannensu ya samu?
Jimillar kuɗin kowannensu naira 15,000 ce.
Me Sabitu ya yi washegari?
Washegari ya koma kasuwa, kuma ya lanƙwasa gwiwoyinsa.

lessons.title: Ginin Malam Ashafa
lessons.summary: In Zaria, the lame but devoted builder Malam Ashafa teaches his apprentice Muhuyi to mix cement and sand; Muhuyi's carelessness ruins five bags in the first rain, Ashafa tells how another man's carelessness lamed him, and they finish the house before the rainy season.
lessons.text:
Malam Ashafa magini ne a birnin Zaria. Ya shafe shekaru 35 yana gina gidaje. Shi gurgu ne: yana tafiya da sanda, kuma ƙafarsa ta hagu ba ta da ƙarfi. Duk da haka ya dukufa ga aikinsa fiye da kowa. Mutane sukan ce, "Babu wanda ya dukufa ga aiki kamar shi."

A bana wani mutum ya ba shi aikin gina gida mai ɗakuna huɗu. Ya ce masa, "Ina so a gama kafin damuna. Idan damuna ta zo, ruwan sama zai hana aiki." Malam Ashafa ya amince. Ya ɗauki wani matashi mai suna Muhuyi domin ya taimaka masa, kuma ya koya masa sana'ar.

A rana ta farko, Malam Ashafa ya nuna wa Muhuyi yadda ake haɗa siminti. Ya ce, "Ka zuba buhun siminti ɗaya a ƙasa, sannan ka zuba bokiti shida na rairayi a kansa. Ka haɗa siminti da rairayi sosai kafin ka zuba ruwa." Muhuyi ya haɗa su, sannan ya fara zuba ruwa. Ya daɗa ruwa, sannan ya sake daɗa wani. Malam Ashafa ya ce, "Kash! Ya isa! Kada ka daɗa ruwa kuma. Idan ruwa ya yi yawa, siminti ba zai yi ƙarfi ba." Sai ya tsoma sandarsa a cikin simintin. Simintin ya zuba daga jikin sandar kamar ruwa. Ya ce, "Ka gani? Yanzu sai mu daɗa rairayi da siminti kaɗan."

Muhuyi yana da saurin koyo, amma yana da sakaci. Wata rana ya bar buhunan siminti biyar a waje, bai rufe su ba. Da dare ruwan sama na farko na damuna ya sauka. Washegari da suka zo, sai suka ga simintin cikin buhunan ya yi tauri kamar dutse. Muhuyi ya ce, "Kash! Na manta da su." Malam Ashafa ya tsoma hannunsa a cikin buhu ɗaya, amma bai iya ɗebo komai ba.

Malam Ashafa ya zauna a kan wani dutse ya ce, "Muhuyi, ka san dalilin da ya sa nake gurgu? Shekaru goma da suka wuce, ina tsaye a saman wani bango. Wani ma'aikaci ya yi sakaci, bai ɗaure katakon da nake tsaye a kai da kyau ba, sai na faɗo. Sakacin minti ɗaya ya sa na zama gurgu har abada. A wannan aiki, sakaci ba ƙaramin abu ba ne."

Muhuyi ya ji kunya ƙwarai. Ya ce, "Ba zan sake yin sakaci ba." Daga ranar ya dukufa ga aikinsa. Kullum yana rufe buhunan siminti da leda kafin ya tafi gida.

Sun gama gidan mako ɗaya kafin ruwan damuna ya yi yawa. Mai gidan ya yi farin ciki, ya ce, "An ce gurgu ba zai iya gini ba. Yau na ga ƙarya ce."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa Malam Ashafa yake tafiya da sanda?
Domin shi gurgu ne: ƙafarsa ta hagu ba ta da ƙarfi.
Me Malam Ashafa ya ce wa Muhuyi game da ruwa?
Ya ce kada ya daɗa ruwa, domin idan ruwa ya yi yawa siminti ba zai yi ƙarfi ba.
Me ya faru da buhunan simintin da Muhuyi ya bari a waje?
Ruwan sama ya sauka a kansu, simintin ya yi tauri kamar dutse.
Me ya sa Malam Ashafa ya zama gurgu?
Wani ma'aikaci ya yi sakaci, sai ya faɗo daga saman bango.
Sun gama gidan kafin damuna?
Eh, sun gama mako ɗaya kafin ruwan damuna ya yi yawa.

lessons.title: Masana'antar yadi
lessons.summary: In a Kaduna textile factory, Zuwairatu and other workers vomit from the dye chemicals and the waste turns a stream filthy; the manager harasses those who complain, the union leader blames the workers' ignorance of their rights, a journalist exposes the factory and it loses in court.
lessons.text:
Zuwairatu tana aiki a wata masana'antar yadi a Kaduna. Masana'antar tana saƙa yadi, sannan tana rina shi da sunadarai iri iri. Aikin Zuwairatu shi ne ta tsoma yadin a cikin manyan tukwanen launi, sannan ta shanya shi.

Tun da ta fara aiki, Zuwairatu ta lura cewa ma'aikata da yawa suna yawan rashin lafiya. Wani lokaci idan sun daɗe kusa da tukwanen, sai su ji jiri, wasu kuma su yi amai. Ita ma wata rana ta yi amai sau uku kafin rana ta yi. Babu safar hannu, babu abin rufe hanci. Warin sunadarai ya cika ko'ina.

Bugu da ƙari, masana'antar tana zuba ruwan launi a cikin wani rafi da ke bayanta. Ruwan rafin ya zama ƙazami, baƙi kamar mai. Mutanen ƙauyen da ke kusa suna amfani da ƙazamin ruwan nan wajen noma. Yaransu ma sun fara yin amai.

Wasu ma'aikata sun kai ƙara ga manajan masana'antar. Amma maimakon ya saurare su, sai ya fara addabar su. Ya rage musu albashi, ya sa su yi aiki har dare, kuma ya ce zai kori duk wanda ya sake magana. Addabar da yake yi musu ta sa kowa ya yi shiru.

Sai Zuwairatu ta je wajen Malam Abdulhafiz, shugaban ƙungiyar ma'aikata. Ya saurare ta, sannan ya ce, "Matsalarmu ita ce jahilci. Ma'aikata da yawa ba su san haƙƙinsu ba. Ba su san cewa doka ta ce dole a ba su kayan kariya ba. Wannan jahilci ne yake sa manajan ya addabe su."

Malam Abdulhafiz ya tara hotuna da takardun asibiti na ma'aikatan da suka yi amai. Ya ɗauki kwalba ɗaya ta ƙazamin ruwan rafin. Sannan ya kai su wajen wata 'yar jarida. Ta rubuta labarin a jarida, ta fallasa abin da masana'antar take yi. Ta fallasa yadda ake zuba sunadarai a rafi, da yadda ake addabar ma'aikata.

Bayan an fallasa labarin, ƙungiyar ma'aikata ta kai masana'antar kotu. Lauyan masana'antar ya yi ƙoƙarin ƙalubalantar ƙungiyar, ya ce babu wata shaida. Amma Malam Abdulhafiz ya ce, "Za mu ƙalubalanta duk abin da ya faɗa. Ga shaidarmu." Ya ɗora hotunan da takardun asibitin a gaban alƙali.

A ƙarshe masana'antar ta sha kaye a kotu. Alƙali ya ce dole ta ba kowane ma'aikaci kayan kariya, ta daina zuba sunadarai a rafi, kuma ta biya ƙauyen diyya. Bayan wannan kaye, manajan ya bar aiki.

Zuwairatu ta ce wa Malam Abdulhafiz, "Ashe ilimi makami ne." Ya ce, "Haka ne. Jahilci ya fi kowace cuta illa."

Tambayoyi:
Wane aiki Zuwairatu take yi a masana'antar yadi?
Tana tsoma yadi a cikin tukwanen launi, sannan ta shanya shi.
Me ya sa ma'aikata suke yin amai?
Saboda warin sunadarai, kuma babu kayan kariya.
Yaya manajan ya addabi ma'aikatan da suka kai ƙara?
Ya rage musu albashi, ya sa su yi aiki har dare, kuma ya ce zai kore su.
Me Malam Abdulhafiz ya ce shi ne matsalar ma'aikata?
Ya ce matsalarsu jahilci ne, domin ba su san haƙƙinsu ba.
Wa ya fallasa abin da masana'antar take yi?
Wata 'yar jarida ce ta fallasa shi a jarida.
Me ya faru da masana'antar a kotu?
Ta sha kaye a kotu.

lessons.title: Shagon Barakatu
lessons.summary: In Katsina, Barakatu opens a phone repair shop, replaces an old man's battery and teaches customers to pay digitally; her cheap, good work makes her popular, an envious neighbour calls her batteries fake, and she answers with a guarantee until he comes to learn from her.
lessons.text:
Barakatu ta koyi gyaran waya a wata makarantar koyon sana'a a Katsina. Bayan ta gama, ta buɗe ƙaramin shago a bakin kasuwa. A farko, kwastomomi kaɗan ne suke zuwa. Mutane sukan ce, "Mace ce za ta gyara mana waya?"

Wata rana wani tsoho ya kawo wayarsa. Ya ce, "'Yata, batirin wayar nan ba ya daɗewa. Da safe na cika shi, amma kafin azahar ya mutu." Barakatu ta buɗe wayar. Ta ga ƙura da yawa a ciki. Sai ta hura ƙurar a hankali, ta sake hura ta har sai da cikin wayar ya yi tsabta. Sannan ta duba batirin. Ta ce, "Baba, batirin ya tsufa. Akwai sabon batiri a nan, kuma ina sayar da shi da arha."

Ta canza batirin. Daga nan ta ga wata waya a ciki ta yanke. Sai ta ɗauki wani guntun waya, ta haɗa guntun da wurin da ya yanke. Bayan haka ta kunna wayar, ta saita lokaci da kwanan wata, kazalika ta saita harshen wayar zuwa Hausa. Tsohon ya yi murna. Ya ce, "Ashe 'ya mace ma tana iya wannan aiki!"

Barakatu ba gyaran waya kaɗai take yi ba. Tana kuma koya wa kwastomominta yadda ake biyan kuɗi ta hanyar dijital. Ta ce musu, "Yanzu duniya ta koma dijital. Ba sai kun ɗauki kuɗi a aljihu ba. Kuna iya biyan kuɗi da wayarku." Wasu kwastomomi sun yi mamaki, wasu kuma sun ji daɗi.

Kayanta suna da arha, kuma aikinta yana da kyau. Saboda haka tagomashinta ya ƙaru. Labarinta ya bazu a kasuwa. Kafin shekara ta cika, kwastomomi suna zuwa mata daga ko'ina a cikin Katsina. Tagomashin da ta samu ya sa ta ɗauki 'yan mata biyu domin su taimaka mata.

Amma wani mai gyaran waya, Mukaila, wanda shagonsa yake kusa da nata, ya fara jin hassada. A da kwastomomi suna zuwa wajensa, amma yanzu sun koma wajen Barakatu. Saboda hassada, ya fara gaya wa mutane cewa baturan da take sayarwa na jabu ne. Ya ce, "Kada ku yarda da kayanta. Arhar nan tana da dalili."

Barakatu ba ta yi faɗa da shi ba. Sai ta rubuta takarda a ƙofar shagonta: "Duk batirin da na sayar, idan ya lalace cikin wata uku, zan ba ka wani." Kazalika ta ajiye takardun kamfanin da take sayen batura daga wurinsa, domin kowa ya gani. Kwastomominta ba su bar ta ba.

Bayan wata uku, Mukaila ya zo shagonta da kunya. Ya ce, "Barakatu, na yi kuskure. Hassada ce ta rufe min ido. Don Allah ki koya min yadda ake biyan kuɗi ta dijital." Barakatu ta yi dariya, ta ce, "Ba laifi. Kasuwa ta isa mu duka."

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa batirin wayar tsohon ba ya daɗewa?
Domin batirin ya tsufa.
Me Barakatu ta yi da guntun waya?
Ta haɗa guntun da wurin da wata waya ta yanke a cikin wayar.
Me Barakatu take koya wa kwastomominta?
Tana koya musu yadda ake biyan kuɗi ta hanyar dijital.
Me ya sa tagomashinta ya ƙaru?
Domin kayanta suna da arha, kuma aikinta yana da kyau.
Me ya sa Mukaila ya ce baturanta na jabu ne?
Saboda hassada, domin kwastomominsa sun koma wajen Barakatu.

lessons.title: Gidan abincin Hajiya Ɗaharatu
lessons.summary: Near a motor park in Gombe, Hajiya Ɗaharatu grinds pepper by hand, serves balls of tuwo and pasta to customers on benches behind a green curtain, loses a piece of meat to her cat when she forgets a lid, sells coconut, and feeds Qur'anic pupils out of generosity.
lessons.text:
Hajiya Ɗaharatu tana da wani ƙaramin gidan abinci kusa da tashar mota a Gombe. Ta shafe shekaru goma sha biyar tana sayar da abinci. Abincin da ta fi sayarwa shi ne tuwon masara da miyar kuka. Kazalika tana dafa taliya da nama ga waɗanda ba sa son tuwo.

Kowace rana Hajiya Ɗaharatu takan tashi tun kafin asuba. Da farko takan je injin niƙa domin a niƙa mata masara. Daga nan takan niƙa tattasai, tumatir da albasa a kan dutse a gida. Ta ce, "Idan na niƙa da hannuna, miyata tana da daɗi fiye da ta inji."

Bayan ta dafa tuwon, takan yi masa dunƙule dunƙule, ta sa su a cikin manyan kwanoni. Kowane dunƙule yana da girman hannun mutum. Taliya kuma takan dafa ta a cikin wata babbar tukunya, sannan ta rufe tukunyar da murfi domin ta ci gaba da zafi.

A gidan abincin akwai benci biyu masu tsawo. Kwastomomi suna zaune a kan benci suna cin abinci. Idan benci ya cika, wasu sukan tsaya. A ƙofar gidan abincin akwai labule mai launin kore. Labulen yana hana ƙura da rana shiga, kuma idan iska ta hura, yakan yi rawa.

Hajiya Ɗaharatu tana da wata kyanwa mai farin jiki. Kyanwar tana kama ɓeraye a cikin ɗakin ajiya. Amma wani lokaci kyanwar takan yi ƙoƙarin satar nama. Wata rana Hajiya ta manta ba ta rufe tukunyar nama da murfi ba. Kyanwar ta haura kan teburi, ta ɗauki tsoka ɗaya, ta gudu ta ɓoye a bayan labule. Kwastomomi suka yi dariya. Daga ranar, Hajiya ba ta sake barin tukunya ba tare da murfi ba.

Bayan cin abinci, kwastomominta sukan sha ruwan kwakwa. Ita kanta ce take fasa kwakwa, ta zuba ruwanta a kofuna, sannan ta yanka namanta guntu guntu. Mutane da yawa suna zuwa domin kwakwarta kaɗai.

Abin da ya fi sa mutane son Hajiya Ɗaharatu shi ne karimcinta. Kowace yamma wasu almajirai suna zuwa ƙofar gidan abincin. Ba ta taɓa korar su ba. Takan ba kowannensu dunƙulen tuwo da miya. Wani mai mota ya tambaye ta, "Hajiya, ba kya tsoron karimcinki ya cinye ribarki?" Ta ce, "Karimci ba ya talauta mutum. Allah yana ganin abin da muke yi."

Washegari mai motar ya dawo da wasu direbobi goma. Ya ce musu, "Wannan ita ce Hajiyar da na faɗa muku." Tun daga ranar, gidan abincin ya fi cika.

Tambayoyi:
Wane abinci Hajiya Ɗaharatu ta fi sayarwa?
Ta fi sayar da tuwon masara da miyar kuka, kuma tana dafa taliya.
Me ya sa take niƙa tattasai da hannunta?
Ta ce idan ta niƙa da hannunta, miyarta tana da daɗi fiye da ta inji.
Me kyanwar ta yi da Hajiya ta manta da murfi?
Ta ɗauki tsoka ɗaya, ta gudu ta ɓoye a bayan labule.
Me Hajiya take ba almajirai?
Takan ba kowannensu dunƙulen tuwo da miya.
Me Hajiya ta ce game da karimci?
Ta ce karimci ba ya talauta mutum.

lessons.title: Makiyayi da ɗansa
lessons.summary: Near Sokoto, the hired herder Hammadi takes his son Yero to the river with forty cows, tells him about the loneliness of the job, cures a sick cow while vultures circle, and stops Yero from stoning an eagle's nest after the boy saves a duckling.
lessons.text:
Hammadi makiyayi ne a kusa da Sokoto. Ba nasa shanun ba ne: yana kiwon shanun wani attajiri a birni, kuma attajirin yana biyan shi kowane wata. Bugu da ƙari, duk shekara yakan ba shi saniya ɗaya. A bana Hammadi ya ɗauki ɗansa Yero, mai shekara goma sha biyu, domin ya koyi aikin.

Da safe suka tashi da shanu 40, suka dosa wajen kogi. Hammadi yana gaba da sanda, Yero yana bayan shanun. Suka yi tafiya har rana ta yi zafi. Babu gida, babu mutum, sai ciyawa da bishiyoyi.

Da yamma suka zauna a ƙarƙashin wata bishiya. Yero ya ce, "Baba, wannan wuri yana da shiru sosai." Hammadi ya ce, "Haka ne. Kaɗaici shi ne abu mafi wuya a wannan aiki. Wani lokaci ina shafe watanni ban ga iyalina ba. Kaɗaici ya fi rana zafi. Shi ya sa na kawo ka."

Washegari, wata saniya ta kwanta, ta ƙi tashi. Cikinta ya kumbura. Ba da daɗewa ba, Yero ya ga wasu manyan tsuntsaye suna zagaye a sama. Ya ce, "Baba, me ne waɗannan?" Hammadi ya ce, "Ungulu ne. Ungulu yana jin ƙamshin dabbar da take gab da mutuwa." Sai ya ɗauko magani daga cikin jakarsa, ya ba saniyar. Bayan awa biyu saniyar ta tashi. Ungulun suka tashi suka tafi.

Da suka isa kogi, suka ga agwagwa da yawa suna iyo a cikin ruwa. Na wani manomi ne da gonarsa take kusa. Yero ya yi farin ciki, ya zauna yana kallon agwagwan.

A kan wata doguwar bishiya kusa da kogin, akwai sheka babba ta wata mikiya. Mikiyar tana zaune a cikin shekarta. Ba zato ba tsammani, mikiyar ta sauko da sauri, ta kama wata ƙaramar agwagwa da ƙafafunta. Yero ya ɗauki dutse ya yi jifa. Jifarsa ta same ta a fiffike, sai ta saki agwagwar a cikin ruwa, ta koma shekarta.

Yero ya ɗauki wani dutse, ya so ya yi jifar sheka. Amma Hammadi ya kama hannunsa. Ya ce, "A'a, ɗana. Mikiya ma tana da 'ya'ya a cikin shekarta. Kowa yana neman abinci. Ka kare agwagwa, wannan ya isa. Amma kada ka lalata gidan wani."

Manomin ya zo ya gode musu. Ya ba su nono da fura. Da maraice suka dosa wajen gida tare da shanunsu, saniyar da ta yi rashin lafiya tana tafiya a gaba.

Tambayoyi:
Ina Hammadi da Yero suka dosa da safe?
Sun dosa wajen kogi tare da shanu 40.
Wa yake biyan Hammadi?
Wani attajiri a birni ne, wanda shanunsa yake kiwo.
Me Hammadi ya ce shi ne abu mafi wuya a aikinsa?
Ya ce kaɗaici shi ne abu mafi wuya.
Me ya sa ungulu suke zagaye a sama?
Domin wata saniya ta yi rashin lafiya, kuma ungulu yana jin ƙamshin dabbar da take gab da mutuwa.
Me mikiyar ta yi?
Ta sauko daga shekarta ta kama wata ƙaramar agwagwa.
Me ya sa Hammadi ya hana Yero jifar sheka?
Domin mikiya ma tana da 'ya'ya a cikin shekarta.

lessons.title: Sintirin farko na Fannami
lessons.summary: In Maiduguri, Fannami receives his police certificate and his mother's kiss, then goes on night patrol with Abdulwasiu, a pampered official's son; they surprise thieves loading cartons of medicine, the gang scatters, and each catches one.
lessons.text:
Fannami ya gama makarantar 'yan sanda a Maiduguri. A ranar bikin, kowane ɗalibi ya karɓi shahadar kammala horo. Da aka kira sunansa, Fannami ya hau dandali ya karɓi shahadarsa a hannun kwamishina. Mahaifiyarsa tana zaune a cikin jama'a. Da ya sauko, ta rungume shi, ta yi masa sumba a goshi. Ta ce, "Ɗana, ka riƙe wannan shahada da gaskiya." Sumbar mahaifiyarsa ta fi shahadar daɗi a gare shi.

Bayan mako guda, aka tura shi aikin sintiri na dare a kasuwar Maiduguri. Abokin aikinsa shi ne Abdulwasiu, wanda mahaifinsa babban mutum ne a gwamnati. Abdulwasiu ya taso cikin gata. Tun yana yaro ba a taɓa hana shi komai ba. Saboda haka ba ya son aiki mai wuya.

A daren farko na sintirinsu, Abdulwasiu ya ce, "Mu zauna a cikin mota kawai. Babu abin da zai faru." Fannami ya ce, "A'a. Sintiri shi ne mu zagaya kasuwa da ƙafa." Abdulwasiu ya yi gunaguni, ya ce, "Ni ba a saba min da irin wannan wahala ba." Fannami ya ce, "Gata yana nan a gida. A wajen aiki, babu gata."

Suka yi sintiri a kan titunan kasuwar har ƙarfe biyu na dare. Sai suka ji ƙara a bayan wani babban shago. Suka leƙa a hankali. Suka ga maza huɗu suna fito da kwalaye daga cikin shagon, suna saka su a cikin wata mota. Kowane kwali yana da nauyi, kuma an rubuta "magani" a jikinsa.

Fannami ya kunna fitila, ya ce, "'Yan sanda! Kowa ya tsaya!" Mutanen suka wargaje: ɗaya ya gudu ta hagu, ɗaya ta dama, biyu kuma suka gudu cikin duhu. Kwali ɗaya ya faɗi daga hannun wani, magunguna suka zube a ƙasa. Fannami ya bi ɗaya daga cikinsu da gudu. Abin mamaki, Abdulwasiu ma ya bi wani. Bayan minti kaɗan, kowannensu ya kamo mutum ɗaya.

Sauran biyun da suka wargaje an kama su washegari, domin waɗanda aka kama sun faɗi sunayensu. Aka mayar da kwalaye 30 na magani ga mai shagon. Mai shagon ya ce, "Da ba ku yi sintiri ba, da na yi asarar duk abin da nake da shi."

Da safe, Abdulwasiu ya ce wa Fannami, "Na ji daɗin daren nan fiye da duk gatan da aka yi min." Fannami ya yi murmushi. Ya ce, "Yanzu ka zama ɗan sanda."

Tambayoyi:
Me mahaifiyar Fannami ta yi bayan ya karɓi shahadarsa?
Ta rungume shi, ta yi masa sumba a goshi.
Me ya sa Abdulwasiu ba ya son aiki mai wuya?
Domin ya taso cikin gata, ba a taɓa hana shi komai ba.
Me suka gani a bayan shagon?
Sun ga maza huɗu suna fito da kwalaye daga cikin shagon.
Me mutanen suka yi da Fannami ya kunna fitila?
Suka wargaje, kowa ya gudu ta wata hanya.
Me Fannami ya ce game da gata?
Ya ce gata yana nan a gida, a wajen aiki babu gata.

lessons.title: Lauya a kotun shari'a
lessons.summary: In Kano, the lawyer Zaliha defends Abdulbari, whom a rival from his Sufi order accuses of adultery before a sharia court led by a great scholar; she has the witness describe what he saw, explains the rule of four witnesses, his conscience makes him confess, and she wins.
lessons.text:
Zaliha lauya ce a Kano. Aikinta shi ne kare mutanen da aka kai su kotun shari'a. Wata rana wani mutum mai suna Abdulbari ya zo ofishinta yana kuka. Ya ce, "Maƙwabcina Ɗanauta ya kai ni kotu. Ya ce na yi zina da wata bazawara a unguwarmu. Wallahi ƙarya ne."

Zaliha ta tambaye shi dalilin da ya sa Ɗanauta zai yi masa haka. Abdulbari ya ce, "Mu biyu muna cikin ɗarika ɗaya. A watan da ya wuce, 'yan ɗarikar suka zaɓe ni shugaban zawiyarmu, ba shi ba. Tun daga lokacin yake neman ya ɓata min suna."

Alƙalin kotun wani tsoho ne, shehu ne a ilimin shari'a. Mutane suna girmama shi sosai, domin shehun malami ne da ya karantar da ɗalibai fiye da dubu. Ranar shari'a, kotun ta cika da mutane, domin labarin zina yakan ja hankalin jama'a.

Ɗanauta ya zo da shaida ɗaya. Zaliha ta tashi, ta ce wa shaidan, "Ka siffanta mana abin da ka gani. Ina ka tsaya? Wace rana ce? Ƙarfe nawa ne?" Shaidan ya fara magana, sannan ya tsaya. Ya kasa siffanta wurin. Ya ce dare ne, sannan ya ce rana ce.

Sai Zaliha ta juya ga alƙali. Ta ce, "Ranka ya daɗe, bari in fayyace abin da shari'a ta ce. Ba a tabbatar da zina sai da shaidu huɗu masu gaskiya, waɗanda duka suka ga abu ɗaya. Kuma duk wanda ya zargi wani da zina ba tare da shaidu huɗu ba, shi ma za a hukunta shi." Shehun ya gyaɗa kai. Ya ce, "Lauya ta fayyace shi daidai."

Daga nan shaidan ya yi shiru na wani lokaci. Lamirinsa ya fara damunsa. Sai ya ce, "Ranka ya daɗe, ban ga komai ba. Ɗanauta ne ya ce in faɗi haka. Lamirina ba zai bar ni in yi ƙarya a gaban Allah ba."

Kotun ta yi hayaniya. Alƙali ya ce Abdulbari ba shi da laifi. Ɗanauta kuma za a hukunta shi saboda zargin ƙarya. Zaliha ta yi galaba a shari'ar. Abokan aikinta suka taya ta murna, suka ce, "Kin yi galaba a kan shari'a mafi wuya a bana."

Amma Zaliha ba ta yi murna sosai ba. Tana jin juyayi ga bazawarar da aka ɓata sunanta a gaban jama'a. Bayan shari'a ta je gidanta. Mata da yawa daga unguwar sun riga sun zo, suna nuna mata juyayi. Bazawarar ta ce, "Na gode da wannan juyayi. Yanzu kowa ya san gaskiya."

Tambayoyi:
Me Ɗanauta ya zargi Abdulbari da shi?
Ya zarge shi da yin zina da wata bazawara.
Me ya sa Ɗanauta yake neman ɓata sunan Abdulbari?
Domin 'yan ɗarikarsu sun zaɓi Abdulbari shugaba, ba shi ba.
Wane irin mutum ne alƙalin?
Tsoho ne, shehu ne a ilimin shari'a.
Me Zaliha ta fayyace wa kotu?
Ta fayyace cewa ba a tabbatar da zina sai da shaidu huɗu.
Me ya sa shaidan ya faɗi gaskiya?
Domin lamirinsa ya fara damunsa.
Wa ya yi galaba a shari'ar?
Zaliha ce ta yi galaba.

lessons.title: Aikin ɗan jarida a lokacin yaƙi
lessons.summary: The reporter Mus'ab tells of his work for a news agency during a war in a neighbouring country: a tyrant ruler, international sanctions, minorities deprived of their rights, gold smuggled to pay soldiers, and a ceasefire that peacekeepers must maintain.
lessons.text:
Sunana Mus'ab. Ni ɗan jarida ne, kuma ina aiki da wani kamfanin dillancin labarai. Aikin kamfanin dillancin labarai shi ne ya tara labarai daga ko'ina a duniya, ya sayar da su ga jaridu, gidajen rediyo da talabijin. Shekaru biyu da suka wuce, kamfanin ya tura ni wata ƙasa maƙwabciya inda ake yaƙi. Ga abin da na koya a can.

Shugaban ƙasar nan azzalumi ne. Ya hau mulki da ƙarfin soja, kuma duk wanda ya soki gwamnatinsa sai a kama shi. Mutane suna kiransa "azzalumin shugaba," amma a ɓoye, domin suna tsoro.

Da yaƙi ya fara, ƙasashen duniya suka ƙaƙaba wa ƙasar takunkumi. Takunkumin ya hana ta sayar da man fetur ga ƙasashen waje, kuma ya hana a sayar mata da makamai. Manufar takunkumin ita ce a tilasta wa gwamnati ta daina yaƙi. Amma takunkumi yana da illa: farashin abinci ya tashi, kuma talakawa ne suka fi shan wahala.

Na ziyarci wani ƙauye inda 'yan tsiraru suke zaune. 'Yan tsirarun nan ba sa magana da harshen da yawancin mutanen ƙasar suke magana da shi, kuma addininsu ma ya bambanta. Gwamnati ta tauye musu haƙƙoƙinsu: ba a ba su damar zaɓe, kuma an tauye musu 'yancin yin kasuwanci. Ƙungiyoyin kare haƙƙin ɗan'adam sun yi kuka game da wannan. Wani tsoho ya ce min, "Ba mu nemi komai ba sai haƙƙinmu na ɗan'adam. Mu ma mutane ne kamar kowa."

Na kuma gano yadda gwamnati take samun kuɗi duk da takunkumin. Ana safarar gwal ta kan iyaka. Ana tona gwal a cikin daji, sannan a yi safararsa zuwa ƙasashen waje da daddare a cikin motocin kaya. Kuɗin gwal ɗin ne ake amfani da shi wajen biyan sojoji. Labarin da na rubuta game da safarar gwal ya bazu a jaridun duniya.

Bayan watanni shida na yaƙi, ɓangarorin biyu suka amince su tsagaita wuta. Aka ce za a tsagaita har sai an kammala tattaunawa. Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya ta tura sojojin kiyaye zaman lafiya domin su wanzar da zaman lafiya a yankin. Aikinsu shi ne su wanzar da tsagaita wutar, su hana kowa ya sake harbi.

Na koya cewa aikin ɗan jarida ba shi da sauƙi. Amma idan ba mu faɗi gaskiya ba, duniya ba za ta san yadda ake tauye haƙƙin ɗan'adam ba. Kamar yadda Hausawa suke cewa, "Gaskiya ɗaci gare ta." Duk da haka dole a faɗe ta.

Tambayoyi:
Me ya sa mutane suke kiran shugaban ƙasar azzalumi?
Domin ya hau mulki da ƙarfin soja, kuma ana kama duk wanda ya soki gwamnatinsa.
Wane aiki kamfanin dillancin labarai yake yi?
Yana tara labarai daga ko'ina a duniya, ya sayar da su ga jaridu, rediyo da talabijin.
Me takunkumin ya hana ƙasar yi?
Ya hana ta sayar da man fetur, kuma ya hana a sayar mata da makamai.
Yaya gwamnati ta tauye haƙƙin 'yan tsiraru?
Ba a ba su damar zaɓe, kuma an tauye musu 'yancin yin kasuwanci.
Yaya gwamnati take samun kuɗi duk da takunkumin?
Ana safarar gwal ta kan iyaka zuwa ƙasashen waje.
Me sojojin kiyaye zaman lafiya za su yi?
Za su wanzar da zaman lafiya, su hana kowa ya sake harbi.

lessons.title: Mawaƙin bikin aure
lessons.summary: In Katsina, the old white-bearded entertainer Malam Barmo writes a long poem for a wedding at the request of the groom's best friend about their lifelong friendship; at the feast the two families mix, he honours the groom's mother and grandmother, and the guests are full of joy.
lessons.text:
Malam Barmo tsoho ne mai farin gemu a Katsina. Gemunsa ya kai ƙirjinsa, kuma kullum yana sanye da farar hula. Aikinsa shi ne nishaɗantarwa. Shekaru 40 ke nan yana rera waƙoƙi a bukukuwan aure da na suna. Mutane sukan ce, "Babu biki mai armashi sai da Malam Barmo." A garin, kowa ya san shi da aikin nishaɗantarwa.

Bayan waƙa, Malam Barmo yana kuma rubuta ƙasida. Ƙasida doguwar waƙa ce mai baituka da yawa. Ya rubuta ƙasidu game da Annabi, game da ilimi, da kuma game da aure.

Wata rana wani saurayi mai suna Nasrullahi ya zo gidansa. Ya ce, "Malam, ni ne aminin ango. Abokina zai yi aure ranar Asabar. Ina so ka rubuta masa ƙasida game da abokantakarmu." Malam Barmo ya tambaye shi, "Tun yaushe kuke abokantaka?" Nasrullahi ya ce, "Tun muna makarantar firamare. Shi ne aminina, kuma ni ne amininsa. Shekaru 20 ke nan."

Malam Barmo ya shafa gemunsa, ya ce, "Abokantaka irin wannan ba ta da yawa a duniya. Zan rubuta." Ya shafe kwana uku yana rubutu. Ya rubuta game da yaran biyu da suka girma tare, game da wahalar da suka sha tare, da kuma game da angon da zai shiga sabuwar rayuwa.

Ranar biki, gidan ango ya cika da mutane. Iyalan ango da na amarya, Marwa, sun haɗu a babban fili. A da ba su san juna ba, amma yanzu cuɗanya ta fara a tsakaninsu. Mata suna gaisawa, maza suna musayar labarai, yara suna wasa tare. Wannan cuɗanya tana da daɗi.

Malam Barmo ya tashi ya fara rera ƙasidarsa. Muryarsa tana da ƙarfi. A tsakiyar ƙasidar, ya juya ga mahaifiyar ango. Ya ce, "Inna, ke ce kika haifi wannan ango, kika rene shi har ya zama mutum." Mahaifiyar ango ta yi murmushi, ta rufe fuskarta da mayafi. Daga nan ya juya ga wata tsohuwa da ke zaune kusa da ita, ya ce, "Inna, ke ma ki ji daɗi, domin ke kakar ango ce."

Mutane suka cika da annashuwa. Wasu suna dariya, wasu suna tafa hannu. Ango da amininsa sun rungumi juna a gaban kowa. Annashuwar ta ci gaba har dare.

Bayan bikin, Nasrullahi ya ba Malam Barmo kuɗi, ya ce, "Malam, aikinka na nishaɗantarwa ya fi kuɗin nan daraja." Malam Barmo ya ce, "Ka riƙe abokantakarku. Ita ce mafi kyau daga cikin ƙasidar."

Tambayoyi:
Wane aiki Malam Barmo yake yi?
Aikinsa shi ne nishaɗantarwa: yana rera waƙoƙi a bukukuwa, kuma yana rubuta ƙasida.
Me ya faru tsakanin iyalan ango da na amarya?
Cuɗanya ta fara a tsakaninsu.
Me Nasrullahi ya so Malam Barmo ya yi?
Ya so ya rubuta ƙasida game da abokantakarsa da ango.
Tun yaushe Nasrullahi da ango suke abokantaka?
Tun suna makarantar firamare, shekaru 20 ke nan.
Me Malam Barmo ya ce wa mahaifiyar ango?
Ya ce, "Inna, ke ce kika haifi wannan ango."
Yaya mutane suka ji bayan ƙasidar?
Sun cika da annashuwa: wasu suna dariya, wasu suna tafa hannu.
